statement_scope: Whole original Problem 1: in the (2n-1,2n,2n-1) semiregular hexagon, the two innermost triangles are covered by one lozenge in exactly one-third of all lozenge tilings; equivalently the central dual edge has probability 1/3 under the uniform perfect matching. One counted problem; the additional family in Theorem 17 is retained context, not another unit.
